name: Goblin Land Mine
description_html: Invisible emplaced bomb tied to a glyph of warding: 8d6 fire in a 15-ft. radius (Ref DC 15 half). Search/Disable Device DC 20. CR 5.

name: Storm Hammer
description_html: +1 shock warhammer dealing +1d6 electricity on a hit. A non-owner who wields it takes 1d6 electricity damage each round (Ref DC 20 to drop). Distinct from the storm hammer spell.

name: Vampiric Runeblade
description_html: +1 longsword dealing +2d6 negative energy vs. living creatures; wielder gains temporary hit points equal to the bonus damage (max = current hp + 10) for 1 hour. Intelligent CE blade (Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 16, Ego 9) with charm person 1/day (DC 16).
